"""Existing local tests; acceptance is a separate checks entry point."""
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from src import order_service, storage, ui


class OrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.directory.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.directory.name) / "orders.sqlite"
        self.connection = storage.connect(self.path)
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)
        order_service.create_order(self.connection, "ORDER-1")

    def test_normal_submit(self):
        self.assertTrue(order_service.submit_order(self.connection, "ORDER-1"))
        self.assertEqual(order_service.read_status(self.connection, "ORDER-1"), "submitted")

    def test_mark_paid_delegates_to_service(self):
        connection = object()
        with mock.patch.object(order_service, "set_status") as set_status:
            self.assertIsNone(ui.mark_paid(connection, "ORDER-1"))
        set_status.assert_called_once_with(connection, "ORDER-1", "paid")

    def test_mark_paid_unknown_order_raises(self):
        changes_before = self.connection.total_changes
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "order not found"):
            ui.mark_paid(self.connection, "MISSING")
        self.assertEqual(self.connection.total_changes, changes_before)
        self.assertEqual(order_service.read_status(self.connection, "ORDER-1"), "pending")

    def test_mark_paid_database_errors_propagate(self):
        for failing_operation in ("read", "write", "commit"):
            with self.subTest(failing_operation=failing_operation):
                connection = mock.Mock()
                cursor = mock.Mock()
                cursor.fetchone.return_value = ("pending",)
                failure = sqlite3.OperationalError(f"{failing_operation} failed")

                def execute(statement, parameters):
                    if failing_operation == "read" or (
                        failing_operation == "write" and statement.startswith("UPDATE")
                    ):
                        raise failure
                    return cursor

                connection.execute.side_effect = execute
                if failing_operation == "commit":
                    connection.commit.side_effect = failure
                with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.OperationalError) as raised:
                    ui.mark_paid(connection, "ORDER-1")
                self.assertIs(raised.exception, failure)
                if failing_operation != "commit":
                    connection.commit.assert_not_called()

    def test_mark_paid_is_persisted(self):
        ui.mark_paid(self.connection, "ORDER-1")
        self.connection.close()
        other = storage.connect(self.path)
        try:
            self.assertEqual(order_service.read_status(other, "ORDER-1"), "paid")
        finally:
            other.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
